title: THE BEST HABIT TRACKER APP!!!
body: How I wish I could kiss the person who made this app. I have never wanted nor have been as consistent in tracking my habits more than ever since I downloaded this app. The widget option is legit a life saver! It makes it so easy for me to remember that I do in fact had not yet completed my habits. I also love the fact that I can add as many habits as I possible want FOR FREE!!!! I wish and hope and pray it will continue to be free and to those who can, please support the developers! <3
